# CNN

> Global news network delivering breaking news, political coverage, world events, and live video streaming across international and domestic affairs.

CNN provides comprehensive 24/7 news coverage with focus on US politics (including Trump administration and elections), international conflicts (Iran-Israel tensions, Middle East), and major world events. Features live programming with anchors like Anderson Cooper and dedicated shows like CNN Newsroom.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- US Politics & Trump Administration
- Iran-Israel Conflict
- Middle East War Coverage
- 2026 Midterm Elections
- World News & International Affairs
- Fact-Checking & Political Analysis
- Current Events
- Russia & Vladimir Putin
- Election Coverage
- National Security
- Live News Programming
- Political News Analysis

## Core News Coverage

- [Breaking News, Latest News and Videos | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/): CNN homepage featuring breaking news, world events, politics, and health

## US Coverage

- [Politics | CNN Politics](https://edition.cnn.com/politics): US politics coverage including Trump, elections, and political analysis
- [US | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/us): Domestic US news covering national security, TSA, and breaking stories

## International News

- [World news - breaking news, video, headlines and opinion | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/world): International news from Europe, Asia, Middle East covering Iran-Israel war

## Live Programming & Shows

- [CNN Live | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/videos/live): Live TV streaming with Anderson Cooper and primetime programming
- [CNN Newsroom | CNN](https://edition.cnn.com/shows/newsroom): CNN Newsroom show featuring live news, videos, and current events
